text: Ange's answers to the 35 questions and her updated plan arrived 24 Oct 2026 (written answers, a 1:200 plan with tree species and zones, and a sector map: summer sun, fire risk west to north-west, cool and cold wind from the south to south-east, the desirable view to the north-east, and water flowing west to east). Her note: most of what is on the updated plan is already in place; what is not yet done is written under 'Plan' (breaks in the verge x4 to harvest more rainwater, a spiral herb garden, guild planting in Zone 2 with banana, comfrey, nasturtium and sweet potato, and blocking the ends of the swale). She would also like guild planting in the south-west Zone 3.
